_note: Snapshot of Google reviews from the Ray Rooter Trenchless Business Profile, copied Nov 13, 2026. 'd' is Google's relative date at that time. Refresh periodically.
reviews: Steve and his team gave us a free estimate and told us he was able to install the pipe liner for our sewer. Steve explained everything and showed us videos along the way. They did a great job!

Couldn’t ask more of Steve Ray & his crew. Incredible work they have performed at our house. Not only is our entire sewer line like new - but there was zero excavation, and zero damage to our finished basement despite the very tight space available: there was no more than 6 inches and a 90 degrees turn. It’s incredible how much craftsmanship is on display here. Not to mention, Steve is very professional, very punctual, and you can feel the high standard he sets for himself and his crew. Highly recommend, almost wish I had more work for him!

I had a busted cleanout that was hanging on by a thread and it was my biggest worry all year. Steve and his team were amazing, they fixes the issue and gave me the peace of mind I had been looking for. Better than that, they went above and beyond by leaving everything spotless. This was a pleasant surprise given that they had to jackhammer the floor and apply new cement so I expected a bunch of dust everywhere. These guys are top tier professionals!

I had a cracked/broken sewer line. Steve from Ray Rooter came to clean the line so we can get a good look at it then ran a liner through it to prevent any tree roots from getting back in there. Steve was very professional and was always willing to hop on a call to explain what work was needed, and why. The work was done as efficiently as possible and with minimal disturbance. I'm a very satisfied customer. I highly recommend Ray Rooter if you need plumbing work.

Steve has been doing periodic maintenance pressure cleaning on our 300 foot sewer that is shared by four houses on a private street in Bergen County. Before we engaged his service we were having our sewer cleared of tree roots 3 times a year by the use of a mechanical root cutter. Steve came along and recommended a high pressure water treatment that turned out to be less wear and tear and much more effective in clearing out the roots. Also the price of this process has been much less than the old rotor cutting blade approach. We are now at a stage of only having to do this maintenance cleaning every three years. Steve has been very professional, honest, fairly priced, and prompt. You can’t go wrong with calling on Ray Rooter plumbing for your plumbing needs..my three neighbors and I really do agree that Steve is the best out there.

I had a fantastic experience with Ray Rooter Company! Steven was amazing from start to finish. He took the time to listen to all my concerns and issues, and provided free estimates quickly. His professionalism stood out, and his communication was top-notch. He was always available to answer my calls and text messages right away. Looking forward to be working with him and using his services for our home. Highly recommend this company for anyone in need of reliable and responsive service!

Steve from Ray Rooter came highly recommended and I can now fully recommend him for a great job on our sewer line. From the initial conversation, to the detailed explanation of the work and price proposal, to the completion of the job, we couldn't be happier with the service. They were prompt, operated in a clean work space and the price was better than any other service. And the job was done on time. 5 stars for a great company and true professionals.

Summary: Excellent service, very professional, reasonable price, very happy. I had roots in my Main Line for years. The main would typically get stuck on Saturday, when finding someone to take care of it is a challenging task. I am lucky I found Steven - the Ray Rooter guy. The Ray Rooter guys explained the procedure in details for all the steps and got the job done in just 2 days. They have covered all basement surfaces before beginning the work, very clean very neat. Important: Steven worked with my homeowner Insurance to make sure they have all the claim information they needed. Day one was thorough clean up - they used their modern equipment to clean the pipe inside. Day two - they showed up really early and installed the liner. They stayed until the liner cured and run multiple video inspections throughout the process. Another thorough video inspection before they left, and I now have a root free main! Special thanks for Oscar and Steven for fixing the problem I had for years! The service these guys delivered worth every penny, I am a very happy. Andrew (Fair Lawn, NJ)

Ray came by as promised and on time even in the snow. He ran a camera through our sewer pipe to diagnose the problem Roto-rooter said would cost us $20k and showed us nothing was wrong. So in moments saved us 20K. He also told us we didn’t need to have our pipe cleaned out every year, which Roto-Rooter said we did. Also saving us $500 a year. Nice to have a service you can rely on and trust He also didn’t charge us for visit or the diagnosis. What a fair guy.

I hired Steve from Ray Rooter for a trench-less sewer liner and I only have good things to say. First off, when the owner and guy from pictures shows up to give you a free in person quote it’s off to a great start. The team was professional and on time. Steve explained everything very well in terms easy for a non plumber to understand and was thorough from consultation to showing me the scoped liner after complete. The workers were clean, respectful, and happy. I chose ray rooter over the competition because of the fast response time, amazing price, and Steve is just a really great guy. Financing is available if needed, and payment was not asked for until the job was done. Love these guys!!!!!

Most professional contractor I have ever delt with. Showed up on time for the Free Estimate. Had up to date, high tech camera equipment. Found the problem. Scheduled me for repair and again, showed up on time. Went above and beyond, house is better than new! He and his crew worked on the hottest day in over 100 years... and didn't leave until the job was perfect. AMAZING experience. Cannot recommend highly enough. Needs 100 stars.

Part of my sewer pipe was bellied, causing the pipe to break at the exit from my basement. Steve Ray was one of 4 contractors who provided a repair proposal.. Steve’s proposal was the most comprehensive and fairly priced. For example, the other 3 did not suggest or include adding a cleanout outside my home in their proposals. Steve was also the only one who explained the repair well, and why the pipe bellied, leading to the break. Steve and his crew repaired the pipe and updated the water softener connection to the main sewer line inside my basement. Steve participated in, and closely managed all repair steps. Steve and crew are skilled, efficient, professional, and left my home clean inside and outside. I would hire Ray Rooter again, without hesitation.

Steve and Oscar are THE ABSOLUTE BEST! My husband and I would give Ray Rooter more stars if we could. Their expertise, speed, transparency, pricing and professionalism are next level. Even before we purchased our new home, we were mistakenly under the impression that the existing cleanout had been covered by the patio. Steve knew from experience that this probably wasn’t the case and Oscar located the cleanout within seconds. They were able to jet the line without having to add the extra work of installing a new cleanout. We are so appreciative and will definitely reach out to Ray Rooter for any other needs we have in the future!

Steve at Ray Rooter is a true professional, he communicates when he is on his way to your house, he provides a service of putting a camera down your drain at no cost, when others wanted to charge. He takes the time to explain the entire process in detail and what his recommendation is. I had one vendor make it seem like my sewer line was going to collapse at any day and I needed to address right away. Steve showed me with his camera what was going on and calmed me and explained what he suggested, which ultimately led to us going with Ray Rooter for a trenchless sewer lining along with having to excavate and replace our line inside the house as well. Which him and his crew did timely and did not leave a mess at all, which I was expecting. Highly recommend.

Ray Rooter is reliable and gets the job done right the 1st time. I’ve called Steve for numerous emergencies around my house and they were resolved immediately or next day. I will continue to hire Steve for any of my future plumbing needs and would recommend him to anyone!

Steve is absolutely the guy to go with when lining a pipe. He is honest and his pricing is fair. Roto Rooter tried charging us 19K. We called many people in the area and they all reiterated that Steve is the best in the business and recommended him. He provided fast service and is flexible.

We’ve been dealing with a drain clog issue for a long time, and Steven came out to assess the situation. He was professional, honest, and clearly explained that the problem was beyond his scope and would require involvement from the city. Even though he couldn’t complete the job, he didn’t charge us for the visit. Really appreciate his transparency and integrity—highly recommend!

Steve from Ray Rooter was able to snake my sink drain quickly and without any mess in about ten minutes. I previously had another company out who worked for thirty minutes, could not clear the drain, and charged significantly more. Great experience with Ray Rooter all around, and definitely would not hesitate to recommend!

After we noticed we had a small section of blockage in the sewer line from tree roots we called Ray Rooter to look at the situation and provide us with a free quote. We knew immediately after meeting with him that he was the team that we wanted to work with on this project. From the very beginning he was honest, transparent and genuine guy we wanted on the job. He religned about 170 feet of sewer line on our property and during the work he and team were amazing. They were friendly, down to earth, patient and excellent at answering our questions and educating us on everything he was doing. Of course some jobs have obstacles and we sure did have them and he handled each one with care and professionalism. Overall it was a great experience working with him!! I would highly recommend him and know I can count on him for any other future plumbing work or reviews.

Steve does outstanding work. He recently installed a new faucet in my kitchen sink and has fixed numerous other maintenance projects around the house. He works in a timely and diligent manner, quickly responding and getting the job done right the first time. I plan to continue to hire Steve for any future plumbing needs. I strongly recommend him!

We worked with Steve because we had been getting major clogs in our main pipe line that leads to the public sewer. There were so many tree roots that had infiltrated the pipe and was clogging way too often so we were snaking a lot. We decided to invest and look for a company to do the CIPP treatment that lines your pipes to keep out water for getting to the roots to solve the problem. Steve was awesome at explaining the process and the technology and was very efficient in his work. It is hard to find service providers that are thoughtful, human-centered and also professional and he was able to provide all of that to us. I highly recommend working with him and his services.

I'd been having problems with a toilet not draining. I had another company come out and "rotorootered" it($800) but that didn't really help. A couple week later I called that same company back again. A new guy came out and I got a new story about why it wasn't draining. I then called Ray Rooter. Steve(Ray) came out and told me my septic system was bad...pretty obvious took off tank lid and tank was full to the top(and the yard was wet by the lid). And I had just had it drained a few months before. So I needed to close up the septic tank and connect my house to the sewer. They did a great job. And cleaned up the yard as best they could.

I called Steve because water was backing up into my basement from the sewer line. He came highly recommended from another contractor who had done work on my home. Steve was there the next morning and was able to snake the drain and clear the blockage quickly. He explained what caused and and showed me the inside of my line using his camera, and explained next steps I should take and gave me prices for each option. I wouldn't hesitate to call him again.

We had 2 sewer line backups into our finished basement in 2 months. The 1st company did not fix the problem but Ray Rooter, who we called after the 2nd incident certainly did. They came unclogged the line and using a camera and sonar found a damaged line. They came back to excavate & remove the 20ft damaged line & replaced it with PVC all in one day. They were professional, efficient and thorough. They covered and raked the trench replacing the sidewalk slab without damaging it. I highly recommend Ray Rooter.

Ray could not be more professional and his work is 100% quality! The he calls you back and shows up when he tells you he will. He does not cut corners and will always tell you what the job entails and what the cost will be before he starts the job. I have used Ray for over 10 years and I have never had one complaint or ever had to call him back for any work he has completed in my home. From faucet repair to entire furnace and hot water heater installations he’s done it all and in my home and it’s perfect every time. I don’t usually write reviews but Ray Rooters is worth the write up!

Loved working with Ray Rooter for lining a part of our sewer line. Steve helped us come up with the right solution when there were so many options to choose from. He was very knowledgeable and did a great job of patiently helping us understand what each process was going to entail. Would highly recommend!

Steve and the gentleman working with him (his name is escaping my mind right now) were absolutely professional, polite and honest. I had a sewer back up and found out that I had to get my entire sewer line replaced. I had contacted a few plumbers in the area and all either never showed up or were very delayed in responding. Steve came with a high recommendation and he lived up to the high recommendation! He kept me posted throughout the whole process and clearly set expectations up front of what the process was going to be and when all was said and done it was exactly as he had explained! If you need your sewer line replaced do yourself a favor and give Steve from Ray Rooter a call!
Steve and his crew are the best. So knowledgeable, quick, quiet, good price. Would 100% request them again but don’t think we will ever have to since he fixed it all.

Highly Recommended! Organized. Knowledgeable. Innovative. Professional. Punctual. These are the words that come to my mind immediately after hiring and working with Steve from Ray Rooter! Steve and Oscar found our cleanout quickly when another company couldn't find it. Steve educated me on the process for doing a trenchless sewer liner and the way he would do it for us. They used a picote to clean our sewer line that had a root intrusion in it and prepped the sewer line for the new liner. They took a video of the work and measured exactly what was needed for the new liner. The next day, they shot the liner. Every step of the way, we were informed of what would be used, what would happen, and approximately when things would take place. We were well informed and everything went according to plan! Steve is someone you can depend on to get the job done right with the right materials and I'm very glad we ended up hiring him for the job!

It’s apparent after 5 minutes of meeting Steve that he takes great pride in his work. Steve is a master of his craft and I can’t recommend him enough. He did a trenches sewer line repair for me - he is the best in the business for that in Jersey.

Steve came recommended to me by Dan from Brute Contracting. I can’t begin to say what an amazing job he did hydrojetting my sewer line. He spent hours meticulously hydrojetting the line using the camera as he slowly removed debris left by some other cowboy operation. He worked backwards from clean outs in the yard. He is hardworking, reasonably priced and I will be recommending him to anyone I know who needs this done. Thanks Steve!!

I had an excellent experience with Ray Rooter Plumbing Company. Their team was professional, punctual, and resolved my issue efficiently. I was impressed with their expertise and would highly recommend their services to others.

Gotta say, I felt comfortable talking to Steve about my sewer problem. One thing I can say is that it's pretty easy for plumbers and electricians to take huge advantage of their customers if they want to. He put the camera down the pipe and showed me the problem and what to do about the problem. I don't know how expensive these cameras are but I had 2 other companies at my house for the same problem and I think they did the bare minimum and whacked me with a huge bill for guessing at what they were doing. I know what I need to do going forward now. No more guesswork just call Steve and he will do the right thing.

Steve was recommended to me by a mutual friend of a neighbor. He was able to come the day after I called him. Professional & responsive. 10/10 would work with him again. He resolved a nasty drain clog for us very quickly. Great service!

Ray was super responsive and friendly, arrived right on time, and he and his team were very quick to assess the issue, snake/root the sewer line and provided suggestions on how to address the underlying problem. Would recommend to friends and family as trustworthy and efficient.

Steve was professional and informative and it is clear he has experience with what he does. He was patient and kind and had the most current tools and cameras. He was timely, efficient and responsive. Highly recommend!

By far the best sewer repair man. When 2 inspectors couldn't find our sellers 2nd sewer clean-out, this man went above and beyond. He was able to find a solution to our problem and help us avoid a very costly & unnecessary repair. Super honest, reliable and fair. He is the best!!!

These guys are the best. On time, great work, fair price, really everything you would want. I also definitely recommend the trenchless process; was able to replace the line without damaging the yard or the huge tree in the middle of said yard.
Steve from Ray Rooter was awesome! Had great communication with him prior to installing a new water heater. Good guy and very fair pricing.
Ray Rooter did a great job jetting my main line. He arrived on time and performed the job in a timely fashion as promised. Will continue to use him for my future plumbing needs.
Steve and his team did a great job. They were on time, explained everything clearly and worked efficiently. I definitely recommend them if you're having any kind of sewer issue.
Steven responded to my call immediately, he showed up when he said he would, very professional, clean and got the job done quickly. I would highly recommend Ray Rooter for your plumbing needs!
We highly recommend Ray Rooter to anyone. Steve and Zeke were very professional and thorough.Pleasure to work with and kept our place clean. Highly recommend.
Very reliable team, they're good at their work and keep the working area organized and clean. I would recommend their service.
These guys are terrific. Easy to communicate with, efficient, and do excellent work. Would recommend them to anyone in need of their services.
Same day service, fast and even got our washing machine going by cleaning it's drain too, who knew! Will be hiring him again to do the bathroom!
Steves great. Responded to my after-hours calls and came over the next day to fix my plumbing issues
Excellent work! Highly recommend. Thank you for your quick response and efficient work.
Trustworthy and efficient service along with fair price. You can trust Steve especially during an emergency.
Fast, professional and extremely clean. They were in out and done exactly when they said they would be. Highly recommended!
